    Ibn Ḥajar’s entry

    Translation

    1840- Dharr ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Murhibī (ḍamma on mīm, quiescent rāʾ): trustworthy and devout; accused of irjāʾ; sixth generation; died before 100 AH. [The Six.]

    Taqrīb al-Tahdhīb no. 1840, ed. ʿAwwāma, p. 203

    Translation

    1846- Dhū al-Jawshan al-Ḍibābī (fatḥa on jīm, quiescent wāw, fatḥa on shīn; a dotted consonant and two bāʾs separated by alif), father of Shimr: said to be named Shuraḥbīl or Aws.
